title: How to Moderate Talks, Panels, Meetings, More (Virtual and Beyond!)

reader_summary.headline: Hi, everyone, welcome to the A6 and Z podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hi, everyone, welcome to the A6 and Z podcast. I'm Sonal, and I'm here today with an episode all about one thing, but also many things, which is how to moderate. And I don't mean moderate in life, like everything in moderation.

key_points.text: I mean it in the sense of moderating when you're speaking, whether managing or participating in a meeting, presenting a talk.
key_points.evidence_quote: I mean it in the sense of moderating when you're speaking, whether managing or participating in a meeting, presenting a talk, doing a panel or live discussion, even a podcast, and more.

key_points.text: We also go deep on something that's top of mind right now, given the pandemic.
key_points.evidence_quote: We also go deep on something that's top of mind right now, given the pandemic, which is that many knowledge workers who have the privilege and ability to, to work from home, are now communicating entirely online and virtually, and many will probably continue to do so well beyond.

key_points.text: So how does that change moderation?
key_points.evidence_quote: So how does that change moderation?

key_points.text: Where do the differences between in-person and remote, as well as the evolution of tech and tools, come in?
key_points.evidence_quote: Where do the differences between in-person and remote, as well as the evolution of tech and tools, come in?
